text: Yes, deforestation occurred on this asset in 2023. The evidence shows 0.7 hectares of tree-cover loss, which is 1.2% of the asset area. The loss was observed in the Hansen Global Forest Change dataset (GFC-2025-v1.13) and corroborated by the JRC Global Forest Cover 2020 reference, which confirmed 100% of the event area was forest in 2020. The event meets the minimum size threshold (0.5 ha) and the tree-cover loss threshold (30%).
